nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (Hourly)
nodes.notes: Initiates the automated briefing every 1 hour (Click 'Test workflow' to run immediately)

nodes.name: Fetch Popular Repositories
nodes.notes: Primary API Request: Queries GitHub Search API with Continue On Fail enabled

nodes.name: Check GitHub API Status
nodes.notes: Routes execution to fallback if API fails or rate-limits

nodes.name: Filter & Select Top 5 Repositories
nodes.notes: JavaScript Code Node: Filters archived repos, sorts by stars, selects top 5

nodes.name: Fetch Top Repo README (Enrichment)
nodes.notes: Secondary API Request: Enriches #1 repo with full README documentation metadata

nodes.name: Decode & Process README Preview
nodes.notes: Decodes Base64 buffer, cleans markdown/HTML, extracts clean preview

nodes.name: Evaluate Star Threshold (IF Node)
nodes.notes: Conditional Branch: Checks if #1 repository has >= 10,000 stars for Spotlight tier

nodes.name: Format Spotlight Digest Payload
nodes.notes: Constructs rich green Spotlight Discord Embed with medals & README excerpt

nodes.name: Format Standard Digest Payload
nodes.notes: Constructs standard blue Discord Embed for regular tier repositories

nodes.name: Post Spotlight to Discord
nodes.notes: Dispatches Spotlight payload to Discord Webhook channel

nodes.name: Post Standard to Discord
nodes.notes: Dispatches Standard payload to Discord Webhook channel

nodes.name: Format API Error Alert
nodes.notes: Formats structured error fallback alert payload when GitHub API fails

nodes.name: Post Error Alert to Discord
nodes.notes: Dispatches warning alert to Discord to ensure errors never fail silently
